commits.subject: Test saved chat hover highlighting in the sidebar chooser (#62400)
commits.reason: Keep the upstream saved-chat hover regression unchanged. It exercises the same fullscreen chooser and dispatch used by the fork.
evidence: The diff adds one test module and its registration. It introduces no production or generated files. The combined test module matches the upstream blob.

The fixture paints a saved chat with a title and preview and sends mouse movement through App::handle_tui_event. It inspects both background colors in the terminal buffer, checks that the selected row stays put, and observes a redraw entering the preview and leaving for the heading. Moving within the same saved row requests no extra redraw.
The fork retains its mouse-wheel, selection and retained-paint paths. The recorded target-scoped test complements the broader hover, click and draft-preservation controls.
commits.revisit: Run hovering_a_saved_chat_highlights_both_lines_without_moving_selection in the source-selected native TUI suite on the integrated commit.
